**Big: ~1290 hits in 94 files.** Four places must keep `account_id`.

| Zone | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `services/**` JS vars | ~950 | Safe to rename |
| SQL strings in `services/**` | ~250 | Column stays until a migration renames it |
| `migrations/*.sql` (12) | 61 | Applied history. Editing breaks the down step |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | Generated. `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` + `lib/serialize.js` | 10 | Frozen public wire contract |

`[lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8)` is the seam. Rename the left key only, keep the right one `account_id`.

My call: safe to sign off if scoped to JS names. Ask them to confirm the wire map and vendor dir are untouched.
